label: ZI

notes.grounding: Argument loop near line 544, unconditional exit 0, exit 1 paths, trailing exit-code comment block, OVERALL_PERCENTAGE global, Overall Completion line, set -euo pipefail, bc check, the explicit-if clamp idiom, the vitest file and archive.sh's 90 percent minimum all match the real script. Docked for telling the implementer to copy the --file arm (which reads $2 unguarded and would crash under set -u on a trailing flag) and for an unverified claim that spec-kit reserves exit 3 for a system error.
notes.requirements: Covers exit 3 below N, exit 0 at or above N, byte-identical output, missing/non-integer/out-of-range values, and the --file combination, all testable. REQ-002's acceptance criterion tests only below and above, not the equal-to-N boundary the requirement states (the plan matrix does cover it).
notes.verification: No task ends with a Verify: clause naming a command and expected output. Phase 3 tasks describe checks in prose and the plan has a good case matrix, but implementation tasks T002-T007 carry no verification at all, and T009 only says 'recording the exit status' without stating the expected code per case.
notes.scope: Stays on the one option at Level 1 with one file changed and no invented subsystems or unfilled tokens. Minor drift: T012 asks to confirm archive.sh and completion-state.cjs 'still exit 0', a check on other scripts whose exit status is not governed by this change, and generic DoR/DoD boilerplate.
notes.consistency: spec, plan and tasks agree on exit codes 0/1/3, the 0-100 integer range, the --file rejection and the single file path. Small mismatches: T011 uses a relative test path while spec SC-003 uses the full .skilled path; T012 names completion-state.cjs in the description but only archive.sh as its file.
notes.clarity: A developer could implement it: where each block goes, the gate's exact if-shape, validation before calculation. Open questions a developer would still ask: how to read the value without tripping set -u when --min-percent is last (the plan says 'match --file', which would crash), and which concrete packet is the '64 percent' fixture for T001/T009.
